Jack's ruling 7221127130 (「这些现在都启动开发」) starts it now.

The thread merges main after each one lands and runs overlap-check against #37924 and #37970 before its first push. Open question to epic:#5027#1: the shape stored under metadata.focus (an array or one {object,id}); until it is answered, the reader accepts and pins both shapes.`

repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Claim amendment 1 to 7221210743.
Clause-②: yes (widening). The diff adds two optional public surfaces on published ui packages: `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` ChatbotEnhanced `promptInputHeaderSlot?: ReactNode`, and `@object-ui/app-shell` `UseChatConversationReturn.conversationMetadata`. The precedent is `.changeset/34171-managed-password-refusal-copy.md`. The thread also removes four `@object-ui/i18n` keys (`console.ai.focus.pin`, `switchPrompt`, `switchAccept`, `switchDecline`) that shipped only in 19 prereleases. The contract review rules on whether that removal is a narrowing; if it is, the PR follows the narrowing path (BREAKING section and hand-off).
Premise adds: epic:#5027#1 answered (mailbox 7221293049, cloud main d8912a0). `metadata.focus` is always an array `[{ object, id, label? }]` with one entry, and the key is absent after the user's ×. The reader takes `raw[0]` under string `object`/`id` guards. The single-object branch is dropped.
Everything else in the claim is unchanged (Metadata-protocol none, patch).
